notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (www.muji.com) has no Anthropic/Claude-specific disallow and no blanket 'Disallow: /', so tier (a) was permitted. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) succeeded for every page fetched (homepage, mobile-menu accordion in the SSR HTML, ~35 category listing pages, ~15 product-detail pages for breadcrumb discovery) - no block was ever hit, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed for data (Playwright was tried twice on the heaviest listing pages purely to look for an easier facet UI dump; it hit net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / timeout / target-crash on this specific Next.js commerce app due to page weight (1.2-3.8MB SSR HTML with hundreds of embedded product cards) - this is a tier-(b) technical failure, not a site block, and tier (a) already had everything needed, so no Chrome tab was opened; robots.txt was still checked and contains no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot rule of any kind). TREE: store home (/jp/ja/store) mobile-menu accordion gave first-level children of the two relevant top branches: D00055 '家具・収納・家電' (Furniture/Storage/Appliances) -> children D00019 Furniture(excl), D00041 Bedding, D00016 Storage Items&Cases, D00021 Appliances(excl), D00013 IDEE(excl, furniture sub-brand); D00056 '生活雑貨' (Household Sundries) -> children incl. D00020 Interior Goods, D00033 Towel/Bath/Toilet, D00034 Cleaning/Laundry, D00046 Tableware, D00005 Kitchen Goods, D00042 Travel(excl), D00027 Emergency-prep(excl). This site's deeper subcategory strip is NOT server-rendered (client-side filter facets loaded post-hydration, confirmed empty in raw HTML); it was instead recovered via each product-detail page's own JSON-LD BreadcrumbList (schema.org), which is fully SSR'd and gives the true, verified deepest category path + canonical section code for every leaf. Sampled multiple products per umbrella page (D00020, D00016, D00033, D00046, D00005, D00034, D00042) to map real children and confirm homogeneity/mixed content before deciding what to record. Stopped drilling at the first level that is a single, stable, non-facet-combination category name (did not chase deeper attribute facets such as blackout-grade/fabric-type/color under Curtains, since sampled products there showed the SAME product cross-listed under multiple simultaneous facet URLs - i.e. those are overlapping filter facets, not a clean single-path taxonomy, and summing them would double count). QTY: every qty is the site's own rendered pager text, pattern '<N>件中　1件〜40件表示' (a JSON-LD ItemList numberOfItems on these pages reflects only the current 40-item page, NOT the true total, so it was NOT used for qty - the rendered pager lead text was used instead). EXCLUDED and why: D00019 Furniture, D00021 Appliances, D00013 IDEE (all sampled, furniture/appliance-primary) - out of scope. D00042 Travel (241, packing cubes/pouches/toiletry bottles - personal-carrying travel gear, storage.md SS6 explicitly excludes this). D00027 Emergency-prep kits (140, food+supplies; 2 storage-box SKUs seen but not primary purpose) - excluded. D00034 Cleaning/Laundry (219 sampled across all 6 pages - overwhelmingly detergent/tissue/garbage-bags/hangers/cleaning tools; found only 3-4 laundry-bag/wagon SKUs, all embedded inside a detergent-dominated leaf 'S1070308 衣類用洗剤・洗濯用品' with no clean storage-only URL to isolate them) - excluded, would misrepresent qty if the whole leaf were recorded as Storage. T20035 'バス・トイレ用品' (144, sampled 40 - toiletries/soap/bath-stools/brushes, ~90% non-textile; a few body-cloth SKUs not enough to justify) - excluded from Textile. T20047 'キッチン掃除用品' (32, sampled all - cleaning sponges/detergent/brushes, only 4/32 dish-cloth SKUs) - excluded. T20008 'インテリア雑貨' (44, sampled all - mirrors/photo-frames/planters, 0 textile/storage) - excluded, Wall-Decor/Decorative-Accessories territory. D00046 Tableware bulk (247, sampled 40 - plates/bowls/cutlery/glassware) - excluded as a whole; only its clean child S1070408 (placemats/coasters) recorded. D00005 Kitchen Goods bulk (332, sampled 80 across pages 1-2 - cooking tools/utensils) - excluded as a whole; only its clean children S1070407 (aprons/mitts) and S1070405 (food storage containers) and S1070410 (kitchen storage/organizing boxes) recorded. D00020 'インテリア用品' (365, sampled 40+ across pages 1-9 - genuinely mixed: slippers/photo-frames/mirrors alongside cushions/curtains/blankets/rugs) - excluded as a whole (parent grouping row only); its clean single-purpose children T20010 Curtains, T20011 Cushions, S02801 Rugs&Mats, S10510 Throws recorded individually. S2000321 '収納棚・収納ラック' (Storage Shelves/Racks, 167) - verified via product breadcrumb to be filed under D00019 家具(Furniture), not under D00016 Storage - storage.md SS18/SS21 says defer to the site's explicit Furniture placement, so excluded from Storage. All recorded rows were breadcrumb-verified (h1/title/canonical matched the requested node) before being written.
